props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to absolute by Absolute and cannot be changed.

Accordion.name: Accordion
Accordion.intent: A single- or multi-open disclosure group with shared item, trigger, and panel semantics.

props.name: children
props.description: AccordionItem children that define the expandable sections.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: In single mode, controls whether the currently open item may be closed so no item remains open. It is not used in multiple mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled expanded item value in single mode or expanded item values in multiple mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables all trigger interaction without forcing already-open panels to close.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Switches from single-item selection to an array of independently open item values.

props.name: noDividers
props.description: Removes the default public Divider rendered between adjacent AccordionItem children.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when trigger interaction requests a new expanded value or value array according to the current mode.
props.type: ((value: string | null) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void) | undefined

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled expanded item value in single mode or controlled expanded value array in multiple mode.

props.name: children
props.description: The item AccordionTrigger and AccordionPanel content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables only this item’s trigger interaction without forcing an already-open panel to close.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique item identifier used by the parent Accordion expanded-state model.

props.name: children
props.description: Expandable region content associated with its item trigger. Presence and layout motion keep closing content mounted until exit completes.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content rendered inside the real button.

props.name: collapseIcon
props.description: Icon source shown while this item is expanded.

props.name: expandIcon
props.description: Icon source shown while this item is collapsed.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: Forces the trigger content slot to one line with ellipsis when it exceeds the available width.

AppBar.name: AppBar
AppBar.intent: A top application bar with leading, title, trailing, size, mode, and elevation slots.

props.name: elevated
props.description: Switches the AppBar from its default flat surface to the themed raised surface. Sticky or scroll state never changes elevation automatically.

props.name: leading
props.description: Content rendered in the leading action region.

props.name: mode
props.description: Chooses full-width or floating geometry. Full removes outer margin and radius; floating keeps themed margin and radius.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed AppBar height, slot margins, gap, and default title typography role.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Uses native position: sticky with top: 0 while preserving the same visual state and elevation.

props.name: title
props.description: Required direct Weave Text element rendered in the title region. An explicit Text typo overrides the size default.

props.name: titleAlign
props.description: Aligns the title within the real middle grid region; it does not force absolute centering against the viewport.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content rendered in the trailing action region.

Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.intent: Displays a person or entity image with a semantic name and fallback content.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Explicit fallback content shown when no usable image is available. It takes precedence over initials generated from name.

props.name: name
props.description: Entity name used to generate initials when no image or explicit fallback is available; it does not replace accessible labeling in viewProps.

props.name: src
props.description: Optional image source. A successfully loaded image wins over fallback content; load failure automatically falls back.

Badge.name: Badge
Badge.intent: Anchors a compact text or dot indicator to another piece of content.

props.name: children
props.description: Target content that the Badge attaches to. The badge is positioned from the target’s live visual bounds without taking normal layout space.

props.name: dot
props.description: Switches to the dot-only visual mode. When true, text is not allowed and the dot is treated as decorative.

props.name: placement
props.description: Chooses one of eight edge positions around the target and also determines the direction of enter and exit motion.

props.name: text
props.description: Visible badge content in normal mode. Required unless dot is true and omitted entirely in dot mode.

props.name: visible
props.description: Shows or hides only the badge indicator while keeping the wrapped children mounted and visible.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom button content. When children is used, text, icon, and iconPosition are not allowed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native button, prevents pointer and keyboard activation, and applies the shared disabled state. It takes precedence over pressed styling.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon source for the semantic content mode. With no text it creates an icon-only button; it cannot be combined with children.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Places the semantic-mode icon before or after text. It has no effect in custom children mode.

props.name: lg
props.description: Overrides supported props at the lg viewport breakpoint.

props.name: md
props.description: Overrides supported props at the md viewport breakpoint.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled persistent toggle-button state. When provided, Button exposes aria-pressed; when omitted, Button remains a normal push button.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed control size, including minimum height, padding, content gap, and typography role.

props.name: sm
props.description: Overrides supported props at the sm viewport breakpoint.

props.name: text
props.description: Visible semantic button label. It can be paired with icon, and cannot be combined with custom children.

props.name: type
props.description: Sets the native button type. The default is button; use submit or reset only when native form behavior is intended.

props.name: variant
props.description: Selects the themed visual variant: primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost, or danger.

props.name: xl
props.description: Overrides supported props at the xl viewport breakpoint.

Card.name: Card
Card.intent: A themed surface that can optionally expose click and selection states.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the Card surface.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Enables Card activation and keyboard activation. It is independent from selectable and uses viewProps.onClick for the activation handler.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selected state for an uncontrolled selectable Card. It is available only when selectable is true.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called when Card activation requests a selection toggle. Calling preventDefault in viewProps.onClick cancels that default toggle.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Enables boolean selection and aria-pressed semantics. Only selectable Cards may use selected, defaultSelected, and onSelectedChange.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state for a selectable Card. When provided, the parent owns the current selection value.

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
Checkbox.intent: A checkbox control with checked, indeterminate, disabled, label, and size states.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state for the native checkbox input.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled Checkbox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native checkbox input and its bound label interaction.

props.name: group
props.description: Framework group key mapped directly to the native name attribute. Checkboxes with the same group share a submission name while keeping independent checked states.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Sets the native indeterminate property and exposes mixed accessibility state. It does not replace the underlying boolean checked value.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible native-bound label content. Clicking the label toggles this checkbox and contributes to its accessible name.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the native boolean checked state when this checkbox changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed control and surrounding state-layer geometry size.

props.name: value
props.description: Native checkbox value submitted when this option is checked.

Code.name: Code
Code.intent: A syntax-highlighted code block backed by Weave typography and scrolling behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Source code string rendered inside the highlighted code block.

props.name: language
props.description: Required syntax language. Use a Shiki bundled language name, or "custom" together with syntax.

props.name: syntax
props.description: Custom Shiki language registration. Required only when language is "custom" and forbidden for bundled languages.

props.name: direction
props.description: Fixed to column by Column and cannot be changed.

props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to flex by Column and cannot be changed.

Combobox.name: Combobox
Combobox.intent: Searchable/editable single-value listbox that combines text input with option selection.
preferWhen: users search a known option set
avoidWhen: a simple non-editable known option set is sufficient

props.name: children
props.description: ComboboxOption children that define the fixed set of selectable choices.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Controls the built-in clear action. Clearing explicitly sets value to null and clears the input text.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the built-in clear action.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial editable text for uncontrolled input state. It does not select an option by itself.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup visibility when open state is uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial committed option value for uncontrolled selection; null means no selected option.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables editing, popup interaction, selection, and clearing.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: Content shown in the listbox when filtering leaves no visible options.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom option filter called with option metadata and the current input text. When omitted, Combobox uses case-insensitive substring matching on textValue.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled editable input text. Typing changes this state without changing the committed value.

props.name: listboxViewProps
props.description: Applies View customization to the popup listbox without replacing its listbox semantics or positioning.

props.name: name
props.description: Optional native form field name used to submit the committed selected value.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the input anchor and popup along the placement axis.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called when editable input text changes through typing, selection synchronization, or clearing.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when interaction requests a change to popup visibility.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when an option is committed or the control is cleared. Typing alone does not call it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popup visibility.

props.name: overlapTrigger
props.description: Allows the popup to overlap the input anchor instead of being positioned outside its edge.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown in the editable input when it is empty.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred anchored-overlay placement for the listbox popup.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled committed option value. It is independent from inputValue; null means no selected option.

props.name: viewportPadding
props.description: Minimum collision padding kept between the popup and viewport edges.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this option and excludes it from selection, keyboard navigation, and filtering results that can be committed.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon shown with the option and with the committed selection.

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Supplementary text shown in the popup option.

props.name: text
props.description: Primary visible option content.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Stable plain-text representation used for filtering and input synchronization when text is not directly string-like.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique string value committed by this option within its Combobox.

DataGrid.name: DataGrid
DataGrid.intent: Interactive data table with data-grid behaviors.

props.name: columns
props.description: Ordered data-column definitions. Each column has a stable id, header renderer, cell renderer, and optional sort/resizing constraints.

props.name: columnWidths
props.description: Controlled complete column-width map in CSS pixels. When provided, the parent owns resized widths.

props.name: defaultColumnWidths
props.description: Initial CSS-pixel column widths for uncontrolled resizing state.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial atomic Table cell selection for an uncontrolled selectable DataGrid.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort state for uncontrolled sorting.

props.name: dense
props.description: Forwards the dense padding preset to the underlying Table.

props.name: onColumnWidthsChange
props.description: Called continuously while a resizable column changes, with the complete current width map.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the complete atomic Table cell selection after selection changes.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when sortable-header interaction requests a new sort column/direction.

props.name: rows
props.description: Input rows to render. Every row must provide a stable id used for rendering and selection.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Enables the underlying Table cell/row/table selection model using one atomic selected-cell set.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled atomic Table cell selection for the DataGrid.

props.name: sort
props.description: Controlled sort state. null means no active sort; only columns with a comparator can become sorted.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Forwards native sticky-header behavior to the underlying Table.

props.name: verticalBorders
props.description: Forwards vertical cell dividers to the underlying Table.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Enables row windowing while preserving native table structure and selection knowledge for the complete row set.

Dialog.name: Dialog
Dialog.intent: Focused dialog surface, modal or non-modal according to its API.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Non-modal only. Forwards to Popover and controls whether opening moves focus into the dialog content.

props.name: children
props.description: Dialog content rendered inside the non-modal Popover or modal native dialog surface.

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Modal only. Allows a click in the native dialog backdrop region to request closing. The default is false.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Modal only. Allows the native dialog cancel event from Escape to request closing. The default is true.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when Dialog is uncontrolled.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Modal only. Focus target used immediately after showModal(); when omitted, native dialog focusing behavior is preserved.

props.name: modal
props.description: Selects the implementation branch: false or omitted reuses Popover; true uses a native dialog opened with showModal().

props.name: offset
props.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the anchor-to-surface distance to Popover.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when Dialog interaction or native dialog behavior requests an open-state change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled Dialog open state.

props.name: placement
props.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the preferred anchored placement to Popover, including its collision handling.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Controls whether focus returns to the previously focused element after closing. It defaults to true.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Non-modal only. Required trigger element used by Popover as both the anchor and open/close control.

props.name: viewportPadding
props.description: Non-modal only. Forwards the minimum collision padding between the Popover surface and viewport edges.

Divider.name: Divider
Divider.intent: A horizontal or vertical separator with configurable gap and line thickness.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses a horizontal or vertical separator and sets the matching separator orientation semantics.

props.name: gap
props.description: Adds whitespace on both sides of the line: top/bottom for horizontal dividers and left/right for vertical dividers. A value of 0 adds no layout space.

props.name: size
props.description: Sets line thickness in pixels. Unlike normal numeric Length values, this number is always px and overrides the theme thickness.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: In auto mode, names the current Theme breakpoint where Drawer switches from modal below it to non-modal at or above it. The default is md.

props.name: children
props.description: Main-view content shown alongside or behind the Drawer surface.

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Modal only. Allows clicks on the native dialog backdrop to request closing. The default is true.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Modal only. Allows Escape through the native Dialog cancel event to request closing. The default is true.

props.name: closeThreshold
props.description: Modal only below the Theme md breakpoint. Swipe distance required to request closing; the default is 64px.

props.name: collapseThreshold
props.description: Non-modal only. SplitBox drag threshold where the Drawer snaps closed; the default is 32px.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when Drawer is uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial uncontrolled Drawer size along its side axis. It is mutually exclusive with size; when neither is provided, the default is 320px.

props.name: drawer
props.description: Drawer content. The same React subtree is moved between modal and non-modal hosts so its internal state is preserved.

props.name: drawerViewProps
props.description: Configures the Drawer surface itself, including explicit surface styling and its AutoScrollbar settings.

props.name: expandThreshold
props.description: Non-modal only. SplitBox drag distance required to reopen a collapsed Drawer to minSize; the default is 64px.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Modal only. Focus target forwarded to the underlying modal Dialog after showModal().

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum Drawer size along its side axis; the default is 192px.

props.name: mode
props.description: Chooses auto, modal, or non-modal behavior. Auto is the default and switches at breakpoint.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when Drawer interaction requests an open-state change. Responsive mode changes do not call it.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Called with the current CSS size string when Drawer resizing requests a new size.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled Drawer open state.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Controls SplitBox pointer and keyboard resizing in non-modal mode. The default is true.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Modal only. Controls whether closing restores the previously focused element. The default is true.

props.name: side
props.description: Chooses the viewport edge for the Drawer and therefore whether its size controls width or height. The default is right.

props.name: size
props.description: Controlled Drawer size along its side axis. It is mutually exclusive with defaultSize.

Flex.name: Flex
Flex.intent: Generic flex layout when Row or Column would not express the intended axis clearly.
avoidWhen: a fixed vertical sequence can use Column
a fixed horizontal sequence can use Row

props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to flex by Flex and cannot be changed.

Form.name: Form
Form.intent: A semantic form root that preserves native submit/reset behavior while using Weave layout.

props.name: children
props.description: Form controls, fields, and actions rendered inside the native form element.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Receives the React reset event from the real form element when native form reset occurs.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Receives the React submit event from the real form element. Browser constraint validation remains enabled by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting field description. FormDescription must be used inside FormField so participating controls can reference its stable id.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible field error content. FormError must be used inside FormField so participating controls can reference its stable id.

props.name: children
props.description: Field control and optional explicit FormLabel, FormDescription, or FormError parts.

props.name: description
props.description: Convenience description content linked to participating controls through aria-describedby. Do not also provide an explicit FormDescription.

props.name: error
props.description: Convenience error content shown immediately and linked to participating controls; its presence also marks them invalid. Do not also provide an explicit FormError.

props.name: label
props.description: Convenience field label linked to participating controls through aria-labelledby. Do not also provide an explicit FormLabel.

props.name: required
props.description: Propagates required semantics to participating controls and native required where the control is a real validation candidate.

props.name: children
props.description: Grouped form content rendered inside a real fieldset without adding a Card or raised surface.

props.name: children
props.description: Field label content. FormLabel must be used inside FormField so it can use the field’s stable label id.

props.name: children
props.description: Legend content rendered by a real legend element for a FormFieldset.

props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to grid by Grid and cannot be changed.

Icon.name: Icon
Icon.intent: Renders an icon source through Weave size, stroke, color, and ViewHost semantics.

props.name: icon
props.description: Tabler-style React icon component to render. Mutually exclusive with svg so the icon can be statically imported and tree-shaken.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed icon box size.

props.name: stroke
props.description: Selects the themed stroke width applied to outline icons; filled icon geometry remains defined by the icon itself.

props.name: svg
props.description: Custom React SVG element to render instead of an icon component. Mutually exclusive with icon.

Image.name: Image
Image.intent: An image host with explicit fit, position, loading, and accessible alternative text.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alternative text for the image. Use an empty string when the image is purely decorative.

props.name: fit
props.description: Controls how the image content is resized within its rendered box.

props.name: loading
props.description: Chooses native lazy or eager image loading.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the native image element fails to load its source.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called when the native image element successfully loads its source.

props.name: position
props.description: Sets the image position inside its box when the fit mode leaves extra or cropped space.

props.name: src
props.description: Image source as a URL-like string, data/object URL, or Blob.

Input.name: Input
Input.intent: Single-line or multiline free-form native text input.
avoidWhen: the user must choose only from known options

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file extensions or MIME types for type="file".

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Passes the native autocomplete hint to the input or textarea host.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Controls the built-in clear action for single-line Input. It defaults to true and is unavailable in multiline mode.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the single-line clear action. It is used only when the clear action is available.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for an uncontrolled Input. Use value instead when the parent owns the current value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native input or textarea and prevents editing and clear interaction.

props.name: dropzone
props.description: Accept files dragged onto type="file"; disabled by default.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Non-interactive leading icon for single-line Input. It is unavailable in multiline mode.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 language tag for custom color, calendar and clock pickers.

props.name: mask
props.description: Optional character(s) to display instead of the native password mask.

props.name: max
props.description: Sets the native upper value constraint on supported single-line input types.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Passes the native maximum text length constraint to the input or textarea.

props.name: min
props.description: Sets the native lower value constraint on supported single-line input types.

props.name: minLength
props.description: Passes the native minimum text length constraint to the input or textarea.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Switches the native host from input to textarea. Multiline mode disables type, clear action, and leading/trailing icons.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow selecting several files when type="file".

props.name: name
props.description: Sets the native form field name used for form submission.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the current string value whenever the user edits the field or activates the clear action.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Passes the native validation pattern to the input or textarea.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Sets placeholder text shown while the field has no value.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the field non-editable while keeping its value focusable and available for selection.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the native field as required for form validation.

props.name: rows
props.description: Sets the visible textarea row count in multiline mode.

props.name: step
props.description: Passes the native step constraint to number and temporal input types; time and datetime-local steps use seconds, month uses months, week uses weeks.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: A focusable action displayed inside the trailing edge of a single-line Input.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Non-interactive trailing icon for single-line Input. When clear is also visible, this icon remains the rightmost adornment.

props.name: type
props.description: Sets the native single-line input type, including color and temporal types. Color uses the Weave color/HEX Popover; temporal types use Weave calendar or clock Popovers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled field value. When provided, the parent owns the rendered value and must update it from onChange.

Link.name: Link
avoidWhen: the intent is an in-place action

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hides the decorative link icon appended after the visible label without changing the accessible name or navigation behavior.

props.name: hideUnderline
props.description: Hides the animated bottom link marker while preserving text, icon, focus outline, and native anchor behavior.

props.name: href
props.description: Required native anchor destination. When text is omitted, href is also used as the visible label.

props.name: target
props.description: Passes the native target value to the real anchor element without rewriting navigation or automatically changing rel.

props.name: text
props.description: Optional visible label. It replaces the displayed href text but never changes the actual navigation destination.

List.name: List
List.intent: A vertical or horizontal item collection with optional selection and virtualization semantics.

props.name: children
props.description: Compound ListItem content entry mode. It is mutually exclusive with items.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial uncontrolled selection: string or null in single mode, or an array of ids in multiple mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the whole List for selection and roving focus, including all contained items.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between list entries using View spacing semantics; numeric values are px units.

props.name: items
props.description: Data-driven list content. Each item supplies a stable id plus text and optional icon, secondary text, trailing content, or disabled state; mutually exclusive with children.

props.name: noDividers
props.description: Suppresses the default zero-gap Divider inserted between neighboring entries without changing selection or layout behavior.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when selection changes: string or null for single selection, or an array of ids for multiple selection.
props.type: ((selected: string | null) => void) | ((selected: readonly string[]) => void) | undefined

props.name: orientation
props.description: Chooses vertical or horizontal layout and matching arrow-key navigation. The default is vertical.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection value: string or null in single mode, or an array of ids in multiple mode.

props.name: selection
props.description: Chooses none, single, or multiple selection semantics. The default is none; selection props are unavailable in none mode.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: Applies Text.singleLine behavior to supported primary/secondary and direct Text content so overflowing text truncates with an ellipsis.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Enables windowed rendering of the viewport plus overscan while preserving the roving focus target and using the List itself as the scroll container.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom row content rendered inside this list item; direct text content participates in List singleLine behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables selection and removes this item from roving keyboard navigation; parent List disabled state also disables it.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable list-item identity used for selection, focus, and virtualization. Use viewProps.id separately for a DOM id.

MarkSlider.name: MarkSlider
MarkSlider.intent: A Slider variant with explicit value marks and optional mark-only value restriction.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value inherited from Slider and normalized to the current range or nearest mark when restricted.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses the shared Slider horizontal or vertical value axis.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer and keyboard value changes.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Reverses the shared Slider spatial value axis without changing numeric values.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible non-clickable descriptive content used as the slider accessible label.

props.name: marks
props.description: Explicit mark definitions. Each flag is a real numeric position on the Slider value axis and each label is display content for that position.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum numeric value and the default end-point mark.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum numeric value and the default start-point mark.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name for the underlying range input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the normalized value. In restricted mode emitted values are always one of the legal mark flags.

props.name: restricted
props.description: Restricts every stable value to the merged mark flags, snapping pointer, keyboard, controlled, and uncontrolled values to the nearest legal mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the shared Slider visual and interaction geometry size.

props.name: step
props.description: Controls normal range stepping when restricted is false; it never generates MarkSlider marks.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value inherited from Slider and normalized to the nearest legal mark when restricted.

Menu.name: Menu
Menu.intent: Menu/command surface with menu-item keyboard semantics.

props.name: children
props.description: MenuItem and Divider content rendered inside the root menu surface.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Controls whether activating a normal item closes the entire menu tree by default. Individual MenuItem values can override it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial root-menu visibility when open state is uncontrolled.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the root menu and its trigger. The default is 6px, or 0 when overlapTrigger is true and offset is omitted.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when trigger interaction, outside dismissal, Escape, or anchor-hidden dismissal requests a visibility change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled root-menu visibility.

props.name: overlapTrigger
props.description: Changes root positioning so the menu may overlap the trigger instead of starting outside it. The default is false.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred one of eight root-menu placements. Collision handling may flip or shift the resolved placement; the default is bottom-left.

props.name: submenuOffset
props.description: Distance between each submenu surface and its parent item. The default is 4px.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Single element used as the menu anchor and trigger with menu-specific expanded/controls semantics.

props.name: viewportPadding
props.description: Minimum collision padding kept between root/submenu surfaces and viewport edges. The default is 8px.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Overrides Menu closeOnSelect for this normal item. It is ignored when the item opens a submenu instead of selecting.

props.name: danger
props.description: Applies the Menu danger visual treatment without changing activation semantics.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables activation and removes the item from roving keyboard navigation while preserving disabled semantics.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon rendered before the primary and secondary text.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when this normal command item is activated by pointer, Enter, or Space. Submenu parent activation opens the submenu instead.

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Optional secondary text rendered below or alongside the primary item text according to Menu styling.

props.name: submenu
props.description: Nested MenuItem/Divider content for a recursively positioned submenu. Providing it makes this item a submenu parent.

props.name: text
props.description: Primary visible command label for the menu item.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Controls whether opening moves focus to the first focusable element in the panel, falling back to the panel itself.

props.name: children
props.description: Single trigger element used as the anchored-overlay reference and open/close control.

props.name: content
props.description: Interactive content rendered inside the non-modal dialog surface.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial visibility when Popover open state is uncontrolled.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the resolved panel placement and the trigger anchor.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when trigger activation, outside pointer, Escape, anchor dismissal, or programmatic interaction requests a visibility change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled Popover visibility.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred one of eight anchored placements. Collision handling may flip and shift to a better resolved placement.

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Controls whether non-pointer dismissal restores focus to the trigger when focus is still in the panel or document body.

props.name: viewportPadding
props.description: Minimum collision padding kept between the panel and viewport edges.

Presence.name: Presence
Presence.intent: Enter/exit mount lifecycle orchestration without producing its own DOM.
preferWhen: exit content must remain mounted until exit motion completes

props.name: children
props.description: Content kept mounted while Presence coordinates enter and exit lifecycles.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Called after every registered descendant exit has completed and the subtree can unmount.

props.name: present
props.description: Controls whether the subtree should be present; false waits for descendant exit motion before unmounting.

Progress.name: Progress
Progress.intent: A spin or linear progress indicator supporting determinate and indeterminate states.

props.name: color
props.description: Overrides the foreground progress color with a theme color token or direct color value.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses horizontal or vertical motion/fill for linear mode. Spin mode does not use a direction axis.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Selects continuous indeterminate state. When true, progress is not allowed.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Reverses the linear fill and motion direction without changing the progress value.

props.name: mode
props.description: Chooses circular spin or linear progress geometry.

props.name: progress
props.description: Determinate progress value from 0 to 1. It is mutually exclusive with indeterminate=true.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed thickness and overall geometry size.

props.name: speed
props.description: Controls indeterminate loop speed or the one-time determinate value transition duration. Numeric values are milliseconds.

props.name: tracked
props.description: Shows the lighter continuous background track behind the foreground progress.

Radio.name: Radio
preferWhen: a small option set should remain visible

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state for the native radio input.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled Radio.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native radio input and its bound label interaction.

props.name: group
props.description: Framework group key mapped directly to the native name attribute. Radios with the same group participate in the same browser-managed exclusive group.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible native-bound label content. Clicking the label activates this radio and contributes to its accessible name.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the native boolean checked state when this radio changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed control and surrounding state-layer geometry size.

props.name: value
props.description: Native radio value submitted when this option is checked.

RangeSlider.name: RangeSlider
RangeSlider.intent: A two-thumb range selector that shares Slider geometry, motion, and native input behavior.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled [start, end] range. Values are clamped to min/max and normalized so start never exceeds end.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses the shared Slider horizontal or vertical value axis for both thumbs.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer and keyboard changes for both native range inputs.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Additional accessible name text for the end-value range input.

props.name: endName
props.description: Native form field name for the end-value range input.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Reverses the shared Slider spatial axis without changing start/end numeric ordering.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible non-clickable descriptive content shared by the range control for accessibility.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum numeric value allowed for both thumbs.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum numeric value allowed for both thumbs.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the normalized [start, end] pair when either thumb changes. The two thumb identities never swap.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the shared Slider track, thumb, gap, and interaction geometry size.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Additional accessible name text for the start-value range input.

props.name: startName
props.description: Native form field name for the start-value range input.

props.name: step
props.description: Native numeric step shared by both range inputs. When explicitly positive, the shared Slider step dots are shown.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled [start, end] range. Values are clamped and normalized so start is always less than or equal to end.

props.name: direction
props.description: Fixed to row by Row and cannot be changed.

props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to flex by Row and cannot be changed.

SegmentedButton.name: SegmentedButton
SegmentedButton.intent: Compact mutually exclusive segmented actions or modes.
preferWhen: switching a small set of modes or views
avoidWhen: the control is primarily a form field choice

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selection for uncontrolled single or multiple selection. Its value shape follows the selection mode.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered segments. Each item uses a stable id as its selection value, renders children directly inside a real Button, and may be disabled or customize that Button through viewProps.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when user interaction requests a new selection. The callback value shape follows the selection mode.
props.type: ((selected: string | null) => void) | ((selected: readonly string[]) => void) | undefined

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection value. Use a string or null for single selection and a string array for multiple selection.

props.name: selection
props.description: Chooses no selection, single selection, or multiple selection behavior. The default is none.

props.name: size
props.description: Sets the shared Button size used by every segment.

props.name: variant
props.description: Sets the shared Button visual variant used by every segment.

Select.name: Select
Select.intent: Single-value selection from a known option set without editable text entry.
preferWhen: arbitrary text must not be entered
avoidWhen: searchable editable text is part of the interaction

props.name: children
props.description: SelectOption children that define the fixed set of selectable choices.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when popup visibility is uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected option value for uncontrolled selection; null means no selection.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the combobox trigger and prevents opening or changing the selection.

props.name: listboxViewProps
props.description: Applies View customization to the popup listbox without replacing its listbox semantics or positioning.

props.name: name
props.description: Optional native form field name used to submit the selected value.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the trigger and popup along the placement axis.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when interaction requests a change to popup visibility.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user commits an enabled option.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popup visibility.

props.name: overlapTrigger
props.description: Allows the popup to overlap the trigger instead of being positioned outside its edge.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Content shown in the trigger when no option is selected.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred anchored-overlay placement for the listbox popup.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected option value; null means no selection.

props.name: viewportPadding
props.description: Minimum collision padding kept between the popup and viewport edges.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this option and excludes it from pointer selection, keyboard navigation, and typeahead.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon shown with the option and echoed in the Select trigger when selected.

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Supplementary text shown only inside the popup option, not in the closed trigger.

props.name: text
props.description: Primary visible option content.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Stable plain-text value used for typeahead when text cannot be converted directly to a string.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique string value submitted by this option within its Select.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.intent: A themed loading placeholder with rectangular, circular, and text shapes.

props.name: shape
props.description: Selects rectangle, circle, or single-line text placeholder geometry. Width and height remain controlled through viewProps.

Slider.name: Slider
Slider.intent: A single-value range control with native input semantics and a shared visual value axis.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled state. Values outside min and max are clamped into the current range.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses a horizontal or vertical value axis. Vertical grows from bottom to top unless inverse is true.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer and keyboard value changes on the native range input.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Reverses the spatial min/max endpoints without changing the numeric min, max, or value.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible descriptive content referenced by the range for accessibility. It is not a clickable native label.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum numeric value of the range.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum numeric value of the range.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name for the underlying range input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the normalized numeric value when user interaction changes the slider.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed track, thumb, gap, and interaction geometry size.

props.name: step
props.description: Native numeric step. When explicitly provided and positive, Slider also renders visual step dots.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled numeric value. The rendered value is clamped into min and max.

Snack.name: Snack
Snack.intent: A transient status or alert message rendered through SnackProvider, with lifetime, progress, placement, and semantic variants.

props.name: action
props.description: Shortcut-content action label or content. It must be provided together with onAction and cannot be combined with custom children.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom Snack content. When provided, text, icon, action, and onAction are not used.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial visibility for an uncontrolled declarative Snack. The default is true.

props.name: duration
props.description: Automatic-dismiss lifetime in milliseconds for a non-persistent Snack. The default is 4000ms and negative values clamp to zero.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon for shortcut text content.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Required callback paired with action. Running the action also requests that the current Snack close.

props.name: onDismissed
props.description: Called after the Snack exit transition finishes and the instance is ready to be removed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when lifetime expiry, an action, or other Snack behavior requests a visibility change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility for a declarative Snack.

props.name: persistent
props.description: Disables automatic dismissal and lifetime progress when true. The default is false.

props.name: placement
props.description: Chooses one of six edge-aligned Snack regions and therefore the enter/exit direction. The default is bottom-center.

props.name: progress
props.description: Shows the built-in lifetime Progress for auto-dismiss Snacks and keeps it synchronized with the remaining lifetime. The default is false.

props.name: text
props.description: Primary shortcut-content message. It can be combined with icon and an action pair, but not custom children.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chooses default, success, warning, danger, or info presentation. Warning and danger use alert semantics; the rest use status semantics.

props.name: children
props.description: Application subtree that receives the Snack queue controller through useSnack().

props.name: container
props.description: Optional mount container for this provider's independent Snack regions. Accepts an element, ref, getter, or null; omitted uses the current default portal host.

props.name: children
props.description: Exactly two direct SplitBoxPane children that form the start and end panes.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controlled collapsed pane. false keeps both panes expanded.

props.name: collapseThreshold
props.description: Pointer-drag threshold at which a collapsible pane snaps from its legal minimum size to fully collapsed.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Chooses which pane the user may collapse by dragging the splitter. It does not restrict externally controlled collapsed state.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial collapsed pane when collapsed state is uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial start-pane size for uncontrolled sizing. Use this instead of size when the parent does not own the current size.

props.name: direction
props.description: Chooses a horizontal left/right split or vertical top/bottom split.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer and keyboard splitter resizing while retaining the separator element and disabled semantics.

props.name: expandThreshold
props.description: Pointer-drag threshold a collapsed pane must cross before it snaps back to its current legal minimum size.

props.name: maxEnd
props.description: Maximum allowed size of the end pane.

props.name: maxStart
props.description: Maximum allowed size of the start pane.

props.name: minEnd
props.description: Minimum allowed size of the end pane during normal, non-collapsed layout.

props.name: minStart
props.description: Minimum allowed size of the start pane during normal, non-collapsed layout.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the current start-pane size as a CSS pixel string while resizing and when threshold snapping changes the size.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when user interaction requests a different collapsed pane state.

props.name: size
props.description: Controlled size of the start pane. Use this when the parent owns splitter size.

props.name: step
props.description: Distance moved by each keyboard resize step.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Visible splitter-line thickness. A value of 0 hides the resting line without removing its pointer hit area.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered in one SplitBox layout slot. The pane adds no default surface styling.

Stack.name: Stack
preferWhen: children intentionally occupy the same grid area or overlap

props.name: layout
props.description: Fixed to stack by Stack and cannot be changed.

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.intent: A binary toggle control with native form participation, label, size, and disabled state.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on/off state. When provided, the parent owns the current switch state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial on/off state for an uncontrolled Switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer, keyboard, label, and drag interaction.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible native-bound label content. Clicking the label activates the same switch control and contributes to its accessible name.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name used when the Switch participates in form submission.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the requested boolean state after click, keyboard, label, or drag interaction.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the themed track, thumb, and field geometry size.

props.name: value
props.description: Native form value submitted for the Switch when it is checked.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible content of the native button used as this tab.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native tab button, removes it from default selection and roving navigation, and exposes aria-disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value identifying this tab and linking it to the TabPanel with the same value inside the same Tabs root.

props.name: children
props.description: Tab children rendered inside the tablist together with the single shared moving selection indicator.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content. All panels stay mounted; inactive panels are hidden instead of unmounted.

props.name: value
props.description: Value linking this panel to the Tab with the same value and determining whether the panel is selected.

Table.name: Table
Table.intent: Semantic tabular content composed from public table subcomponents.
avoidWhen: sorting, resizing, selection, or virtualization is required

props.name: children
props.description: TableHeader and TableBody content rendered with native table semantics.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial atomic cell selection for an uncontrolled selectable Table.

props.name: dense
props.description: Uses the dense Table padding preset without changing typography or selection semantics.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the complete atomic selected-cell set after a cell, row, or table selection change.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Enables cell selection and the generated row/table Checkbox column. Selectable body rows and cells require stable ids.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled atomic cell selection. Row and whole-table checked states are derived from this same cell set.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Makes header cells native sticky elements at top: 0 within the Table scroll container.

props.name: verticalBorders
props.description: Shows vertical dividers between adjacent table cells.

props.name: children
props.description: Body rows rendered inside the native table tbody section.

props.name: align
props.description: Sets horizontal alignment for this body cell.

props.name: children
props.description: Body cell content.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable cell identifier used with its TableRow id by selectable Table state. It is required for selectable body cells.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Sets the maximum width constraint for this cell and its column track.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Sets the minimum width constraint for this cell and its column track.

props.name: width
props.description: Sets the preferred width for this cell and its column track.

props.name: align
props.description: Sets horizontal alignment for this header cell.

props.name: children
props.description: Header cell content.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Sets the maximum width constraint for this column header and its column track.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Sets the minimum width constraint for this column header and its column track.

props.name: width
props.description: Sets the preferred width for this column header and its column track.

props.name: children
props.description: Header rows rendered inside the native table thead section.

props.name: children
props.description: Header or body cells rendered inside a native table row.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable body-row identifier used by selectable Table state. It is required for selectable body rows.

Tabs.name: Tabs
Tabs.intent: Coordinates TabList, Tab, and TabPanel with orientation, activation, and indicator variants.

props.name: activation
props.description: Chooses whether roving keyboard focus also selects the focused tab automatically or waits for Enter/Space. The default is automatic.

props.name: children
props.description: Compound TabList, Tab, and TabPanel content sharing this Tabs selection context.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled Tabs. When omitted with no controlled value, the first enabled Tab is selected.

props.name: indicatorThickness
props.description: Overrides the shared selection indicator thickness in CSS pixels; otherwise the Tabs theme value is used.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when user interaction requests a different enabled tab value.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Chooses horizontal or vertical layout, ARIA orientation, and matching arrow-key navigation. The default is horizontal.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected Tab value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chooses underline or pill visuals without changing selection, focus, ARIA, or keyboard behavior. The default is underline.

Text.name: Text
Text.intent: Theme-driven text with typography, emphasis, alignment, wrapping, and case controls.

props.name: align
props.description: Sets horizontal text alignment within the available inline space.

props.name: bold
props.description: Convenience weight toggle: true uses bold and false uses regular; an explicit weight prop takes precedence.

props.name: case
props.description: Transforms text casing without changing the underlying content.

props.name: children
props.description: Text and other content rendered inside the semantic Text host.

props.name: color
props.description: Sets a semantic text color, theme extension token, or direct color value.

props.name: italic
props.description: Switches between italic and normal font style; browser style synthesis remains allowed when no italic face exists.

props.name: letterSpacing
props.description: Overrides character spacing; numeric values use the Weave spacing scale semantics.

props.name: lg
props.description: Overrides supported props at the lg viewport breakpoint.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Overrides line height; numeric values use the Weave scale semantics.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Clamps wrapped text to at most this many lines.

props.name: md
props.description: Overrides supported props at the md viewport breakpoint.

props.name: overflow
props.description: Chooses whether overflowing text is clipped or rendered with an ellipsis.

props.name: overline
props.description: Adds an overline decoration and can be combined with other text decorations.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: Forces one line with no wrapping and ellipsis overflow, overriding wrap, overflow, and maxLines including responsive overrides.

props.name: size
props.description: Overrides the font-size portion of the selected typo style, or sets size without a typo preset.

props.name: sm
props.description: Overrides supported props at the sm viewport breakpoint.

props.name: strikethrough
props.description: Adds a line-through decoration and can be combined with other text decorations.

props.name: typo
props.description: Selects a complete theme typography role and the base semantic host element associated with that role.

props.name: underline
props.description: Adds an underline decoration and can be combined with other text decorations.

props.name: weight
props.description: Sets the exact typography weight and takes precedence over the bold convenience prop.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Controls normal wrapping, no wrapping, or balanced text wrapping.

props.name: xl
props.description: Overrides supported props at the xl viewport breakpoint.

ThemeProvider.name: ThemeProvider
ThemeProvider.intent: Scopes theme definition, color mode, and reduced-motion preference for descendant Weave UI.

props.name: children
props.description: Subtree that receives this provider's merged theme, color mode, and reduced-motion policy.

props.name: mode
props.description: Chooses light, dark, or system color mode. When omitted, the provider inherits the parent requested mode; the root default is system.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Chooses system, reduce, or no-preference motion policy. When omitted, the provider inherits the parent policy; the root default is system.

props.name: theme
props.description: Partial theme definition merged over the inherited theme for this subtree; unspecified values continue to inherit.

props.name: children
props.description: Single target element used as the tooltip anchor. ToolTip does not add a visible layout wrapper around it.

props.name: content
props.description: Tooltip content linked to the target through aria-describedby. Plain text uses the ToolTip typography; complex content is rendered as provided.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial visibility when tooltip open state is uncontrolled.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before pointer or focus presence opens an uncontrolled tooltip.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the tooltip surface and its target anchor.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when pointer, focus, Escape, or controlled interaction requests a visibility change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled tooltip visibility.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side of the target: top, bottom, left, or right.

View.name: View
View.intent: Low-level public construction primitive for component authors and framework infrastructure.
avoidWhen: examples other than the View demo

props.name: active
props.description: Overrides View styles while the element is in its active pointer state.

props.name: align
props.description: Aligns direct children on the cross axis; in Stack it controls vertical item alignment.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description: Overrides cross-axis alignment for this item.

props.name: animation
props.description: Runs a named animation or an explicit keyframe animation.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Sets the preferred width-to-height aspect ratio.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Requests focus when the host element mounts.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Applies blur to content behind the element.

props.name: backdropSaturate
props.description: Applies a saturation multiplier to content behind the element.

props.name: background
props.description: Sets the background using a theme color, direct color, or structured gradient.

props.name: basis
props.description: Sets the flex-basis used to size this item before free space is distributed.

props.name: blend
props.description: Sets the element blend mode.

props.name: blur
props.description: Applies a foreground blur filter.

props.name: border
props.description: Sets border width on all sides.

props.name: borderBottom
props.description: Sets the bottom border width.

props.name: borderBottomColor
props.description: Sets the bottom border color.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Sets border color on all sides.

props.name: borderLeft
props.description: Sets the left border width.

props.name: borderLeftColor
props.description: Sets the left border color.

props.name: borderRight
props.description: Sets the right border width.

props.name: borderRightColor
props.description: Sets the right border color.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Sets the border line style.

props.name: borderTop
props.description: Sets the top border width.

props.name: borderTopColor
props.description: Sets the top border color.

props.name: bottom
props.description: Sets the bottom positional offset.

props.name: brightness
props.description: Applies a brightness filter multiplier.

props.name: busy
props.description: Marks the element as busy through aria-busy.

props.name: checked
props.description: Exposes checked or mixed state through aria-checked.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the host element.

props.name: className
props.description: Adds custom CSS classes to the host element.

props.name: clickable
props.description: Enables the shared hover and active surface treatment without adding click semantics, role, or keyboard behavior.

props.name: clip
props.description: Clips rendering with a CSS string, circle, polygon, or path definition.

props.name: color
props.description: Sets the foreground color using a theme color token or direct color value.

props.name: column
props.description: Places this item at the given grid column.

props.name: columns
props.description: Defines grid column tracks; a number creates that many equal columns.

props.name: columnSpan
props.description: Sets how many grid columns this item spans.

props.name: container
props.description: Names this element as a responsive container for descendant container breakpoints.

props.name: containerLg
props.description: Overrides View styles when the nearest responsive container reaches this breakpoint.

props.name: containerMd
props.description: Overrides View styles when the nearest responsive container reaches this breakpoint.

props.name: containerSm
props.description: Overrides View styles when the nearest responsive container reaches this breakpoint.

props.name: containerXl
props.description: Overrides View styles when the nearest responsive container reaches this breakpoint.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Applies a contrast filter multiplier.

props.name: controls
props.description: References the element controlled by this element through aria-controls.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Sets the pointer cursor shown over the element.

props.name: data
props.description: Adds data-* attributes from a key-value object.

props.name: depthCompensation
props.description: Opt in to built-in physical depth alignment/spacing for this component.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: References the element that supplies the accessible description through aria-describedby.

props.name: description
props.description: Provides an accessible description through aria-description.

props.name: direction
props.description: Sets the flex main-axis direction when using flex layout.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Marks the element as disabled for shared semantics and state styling.

props.name: disabledStyle
props.description: Overrides View styles while the element is disabled.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Enables native drag behavior on the host element.

props.name: enter
props.description: Configures the enter animation used when content appears through Presence.

props.name: exit
props.description: Configures the exit animation used before content is removed through Presence.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Exposes whether the controlled region is expanded through aria-expanded.

props.name: focus
props.description: Overrides View styles while the element has focus.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Makes the element focusable when no semantic component already owns its focus behavior.

props.name: focusVisible
props.description: Overrides View styles while keyboard-style focus indication is visible.

props.name: gap
props.description: Sets spacing between direct layout children.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Applies a grayscale filter amount.

props.name: grow
props.description: Sets the flex-grow factor for this item.

props.name: height
props.description: Sets height; semantic values include fill, fit, and content.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the host element from rendering and layout.

props.name: hover
props.description: Overrides View styles while the pointer hovers the element.

props.name: hueRotate
props.description: Rotates the rendered hue by the given angle.

props.name: id
props.description: Sets the native host element id.

props.name: inset
props.description: Sets all four positional inset offsets.

props.name: insetX
props.description: Sets the left and right positional offsets.

props.name: insetY
props.description: Sets the top and bottom positional offsets.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the current value or state as invalid through aria-invalid.

props.name: justify
props.description: Distributes direct children on the main axis; in Stack it controls horizontal item alignment.

props.name: justifySelf
props.description: Overrides self-alignment on the inline or grid axis for this item.

props.name: label
props.description: Provides the element accessible name through aria-label.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: References the element that supplies the accessible name through aria-labelledby.

props.name: layer
props.description: Assigns the element to a named Weave layer.

props.name: layout
props.description: Selects the low-level View layout strategy. Application layout should normally use Flex, Row, Column, Grid, Stack, or Absolute.

props.name: layoutAnimation
props.description: Animates layout changes and controls how interrupted layout motion behaves.

props.name: left
props.description: Sets the left positional offset.

props.name: level
props.description: Sets aria-level for hierarchical roles that expose a level.

props.name: lg
props.description: Overrides supported props at the lg viewport breakpoint.

props.name: margin
props.description: Sets margin on all sides.

props.name: marginBottom
props.description: Sets the bottom margin.

props.name: marginLeft
props.description: Sets the left margin.

props.name: marginRight
props.description: Sets the right margin.

props.name: marginTop
props.description: Sets the top margin.

props.name: marginX
props.description: Sets horizontal margin on the left and right sides.

props.name: marginY
props.description: Sets vertical margin on the top and bottom sides.

props.name: mask
props.description: Applies a CSS mask image using a string or structured gradient.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Sets the maximum height.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Sets the maximum width.

props.name: md
props.description: Overrides supported props at the md viewport breakpoint.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Sets the minimum height.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Sets the minimum width.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Sets element opacity from 0 to 1.

props.name: order
props.description: Sets this item flex or grid ordering value.

props.name: outlineColor
props.description: Sets the outline color.

props.name: outlineOffset
props.description: Sets the distance between the outline and the element edge.

props.name: outlineStyle
props.description: Sets the outline line style.

props.name: outlineWidth
props.description: Sets the outline width.

props.name: overflow
props.description: Controls overflow behavior on both axes.

props.name: overflowX
props.description: Controls horizontal overflow behavior.

props.name: overflowY
props.description: Controls vertical overflow behavior.

props.name: owns
props.description: References elements owned by this element through aria-owns.

props.name: padding
props.description: Sets padding on all sides.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Sets the bottom padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Sets the left padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Sets the right padding.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Sets the top padding.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Sets horizontal padding on the left and right sides.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Sets vertical padding on the top and bottom sides.

props.name: pointerEvents
props.description: Controls how the element participates in pointer hit testing.

props.name: position
props.description: Sets the CSS positioning scheme for the host element.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Exposes pressed or mixed toggle state through aria-pressed.

props.name: radius
props.description: Sets all corner radii using a semantic radius or explicit length.

props.name: radiusBottomLeft
props.description: Sets the bottom-left corner radius.

props.name: radiusBottomRight
props.description: Sets the bottom-right corner radius.

props.name: radiusTopLeft
props.description: Sets the top-left corner radius.

props.name: radiusTopRight
props.description: Sets the top-right corner radius.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Marks the element as read-only through aria-readonly.

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwards a React ref to the native host element.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the element as required through aria-required.

props.name: right
props.description: Sets the right positional offset.

props.name: role
props.description: Sets the ARIA role exposed by the host element.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Rotates the element by the given angle.

props.name: row
props.description: Places this item at the given grid row.

props.name: rows
props.description: Defines grid row tracks; a number creates that many equal rows.

props.name: rowSpan
props.description: Sets how many grid rows this item spans.

props.name: saturate
props.description: Applies a saturation filter multiplier.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scales the element uniformly.

props.name: scaleX
props.description: Scales the element horizontally.

props.name: scaleY
props.description: Scales the element vertically.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Configures the scrollbar used when this element creates a scroll area.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Controls whether the element text or content can be selected.

props.name: selected
props.description: Exposes selection state through aria-selected.

props.name: sepia
props.description: Applies a sepia filter amount.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Applies a semantic, custom, or multi-layer box shadow.

props.name: shrink
props.description: Sets the flex-shrink factor for this item.

props.name: skewX
props.description: Skews the element horizontally.

props.name: skewY
props.description: Skews the element vertically.

props.name: sm
props.description: Overrides supported props at the sm viewport breakpoint.

props.name: style
props.description: Adds inline CSS properties after Weave resolved styles.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Sets the native tab order value.

props.name: top
props.description: Sets the top positional offset.

props.name: transform
props.description: Applies an ordered list of transform operations when transform order must be explicit.

props.name: transformOrigin
props.description: Sets the origin used by transforms.

props.name: transition
props.description: Configures animated transitions when supported View style values change.

props.name: translateX
props.description: Translates the element horizontally.

props.name: translateY
props.description: Translates the element vertically.

props.name: valueMax
props.description: Sets the maximum numeric value exposed through aria-valuemax.

props.name: valueMin
props.description: Sets the minimum numeric value exposed through aria-valuemin.

props.name: valueNow
props.description: Sets the current numeric value exposed through aria-valuenow.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Provides human-readable text for the current value through aria-valuetext.

props.name: width
props.description: Sets width; semantic values include fill, fit, and content.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Controls flex wrapping; "reverse" uses reverse wrapping.

props.name: xl
props.description: Overrides supported props at the xl viewport breakpoint.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: Sets stacking order within the current stacking context.
